title: Beyond Calibration: Temporal LLM Confidence Assessment Across Languages and Local Settings
abstract: arXiv:2610.27702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are expected to estimate their own uncertainty, with confidence signals used to guide retrieval, adaptive compute allocation, routing, and selective abstention. We investigate whether confidence signals measured at different temporal stages of problem solving encode distinct forms of epistemic information and remain reliable beyond English-centric settings. Inspired by classical meta-memory theory, we distinguish anticipatory pre-solve confidence (Feeling-of-Knowing, FOK) from retrospective post-solve confidence (Judgement-of-Learning, JOL). We evaluate these signals across two frontier LLMs, multiple reasoning domains, translated Marathi benchmarks, and a newly constructed benchmark of genuinely local Marathi factual questions. Across settings, the cheaper pre-solve signal remains weakly calibrated, while post-solve confidence generally provides stronger epistemic alignment despite its additional inference cost.

translated_title: 超越校准：跨语言与本地化场景下大语言模型置信度的时序评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型被期望能够估计自身的不确定性，其置信度信号可用于指导检索、自适应算力分配、路由以及选择性弃答。我们研究了在问题求解的不同时间阶段所测量的置信度信号是否编码了不同形式的认知信息，以及它们在以英语为中心的场景之外是否依然可靠。受经典元记忆理论的启发，我们区分了求解前的预期性置信度（知道感，FOK）与求解后的回溯性置信度（学习判断，JOL）。我们在两个前沿大语言模型、多个推理领域、经翻译的马拉地语基准测试，以及一个新构建的真正本地化的马拉地语事实性问题基准上评估了这些信号。在所有设置中，成本较低的求解前信号仍然校准较弱，而求解后置信度尽管需要额外的推理成本，通常能提供更强的认知对齐。
tldr: 受元记忆理论启发，该研究首次区分了大语言模型求解前（FOK）与求解后（JOL）两个时间阶段的置信度信号，发现求解后置信度在多语言与本地化场景中具有更强的认知对齐，而成本更低的求解前信号则校准较弱。
en_tdlr: Inspired by meta-memory theory, this study distinguishes pre-solve (FOK) from post-solve (JOL) confidence signals in LLMs across languages and local settings, showing that post-solve confidence provides stronger epistemic alignment while the cheaper pre-solve signal remains weakly calibrated.
